out.text: Spiritual Intuition is a universal ability available to any Beyonder, like Spirit Vision. It lets the user sense the flow of fate and changes in destiny before they manifest physically — the soul's early-warning system — and recognise a threat at a glance. Beyonders of the Abyss and Wheel of Fortune pathways are famed for the sharpness of their intuition, but the ability itself belongs to no single pathway. Roll: Roll 3d6. The difficulty class is based on however much current SPI you have — if you have 1 SPI, you need a critical roll (3–4); if you have 9 SPI, you need 9 or lower; and so on.

Spiritual Perception is a universal ability available to any Beyonder, like Spirit Vision. It is an acute awareness of the spiritual world — ghosts, traces of magic, and supernatural phenomena — and lets the user peer into the Astral Body and Spiritual Body of beings, reading their emotional state and spiritual health. Roll: Roll 3d6. The difficulty class is based on however much current SPI you have — if you have 1 SPI, you need a critical roll (3–4); if you have 9 SPI, you need 9 or lower; and so on. The GM calls for this roll whenever supernatural events occur nearby, or whenever you deliberately open your senses to the spiritual world. DANGER: Spiritual Perception can expose the viewer to beings far beyond their comprehension. Looking upon the Spiritual Body of a deity, angel, or sufficiently powerful entity may force a Fright Check at a severe penalty or cause spiritual damage. The GM determines the exact effects based on the entity's nature and the observer's Sequence.

out.name: Phobia (specify)
out.notes: Irrational fear of a specific thing (cities, spiders, crowds, etc.). Fright Check at -2 when exposed; -1 to all rolls while the phobic stimulus is present and unavoidable. Severity depends on how common the trigger is.

out.name: Secret
out.notes: Dangerous hidden truth; exposure has severe consequences

out.name: Sense of Duty
out.notes: Must help/protect certain groups even at personal risk

out.name: Shyness
out.notes: -1 to -2 to social skill rolls depending on severity and audience. Mild (-5): -1 in groups of 6+; Severe (-10): -2 in groups of 3+.

out.name: Social Stigma
out.notes: Society discriminates: Criminal Record -5, Servant Class -5

out.name: Vow (specify)
out.notes: A solemn promise that restricts your actions. Common examples: Poverty (give away all wealth beyond subsistence) -10, Partial Silence (limited speech) -5, Vegetarian -5.
